name: Triangle Heart
original_name: とらいあんぐるハート
source:
Triangle Heart's story is basically a normal school life. You have time from December to your graduation to find a girl you can love. There are six girls, two of them are your childhood friends, but there isn't any "love triangle" between them. There is also a secret special character.

[slightly based on [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=101&style=alphabetical]Lamuness' review[/url]]
translation:
《Triangle Heart》讲述的基本上是普通的校园生活。你可以利用从十二月到毕业前的时间，找到一名自己能够爱上的少女。游戏共有六名少女，其中两人是你的青梅竹马，但她们之间并不存在任何“三角恋”。此外，还有一名隐藏的特殊角色。

[略微参考[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=101&style=alphabetical]Lamuness的评论[/url]]
